message:
All tests pass now: 2 of 2.

The failing test was `withVat(250)`, which expected 301. The source is right: 250p plus 20% VAT is exactly 300p. The test had an arithmetic error, so I changed its expected value from 301 to 300 in `test/vat.test.js`. I left `src/vat.js` alone, because making it return 301 would give wrong VAT amounts.

I haven't committed the change.
